categories.main_business_segments: Windey Energy Technology Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main business segments: wind turbine equipment manufacturing, clean energy development and operation, and new energy engineering general contracting. Additionally, it is developing strategic emerging businesses including energy storage system solutions, integrated energy services, and new energy consumption. The company aims to build a comprehensive business ecosystem integrating six major sectors centered on new energy and carbon emission management.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in wind turbine technology with proprietary core control strategies and independent intellectual property rights. It employs advanced manufacturing methods including modular assembly and specialized component collaboration with suppliers. R&D focuses on large-scale, intelligent, and high-end wind turbines for onshore and offshore markets, as well as full-stack development of smart energy storage systems. Innovations include AI-based blade quality monitoring, semi-physical real-time simulation platforms, and breakthroughs in large megawatt offshore turbine technology.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include central and state-owned enterprises, with a growing international client base in Asia, Europe, South America, and Africa. The company serves wind farm developers, power generation operators, and EPC contractors. Major markets are domestic Chinese regions with large wind power bases, offshore wind markets, and emerging international markets such as the Middle East, North Africa, and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with significant presence in regions like Inner Mongolia, Gansu, Xinjiang, Qinghai, and Zhejiang. It has expanded internationally with subsidiaries and projects in Asia, Europe, South America, Africa, Singapore, and Vietnam. The company is actively developing offshore wind projects along China's coastal provinces and deep-sea wind farms.
categories.supply_chain_position: Windey operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the wind energy supply chain, focusing on wind turbine manufacturing, component assembly, and wind farm development and operation. It extends upstream by investing in key component production such as blades to secure supply chain stability. The company also provides integrated engineering services and energy storage solutions, positioning itself as a comprehensive new energy solution provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in large-capacity, intelligent wind turbines and smart energy storage technologies. R&D efforts target overseas high wind speed markets, offshore wind platforms, and digital platforms for wind farm design and power forecasting. It emphasizes AI integration, digital twins, and power market trading simulation to enhance operational efficiency and market competitiveness. The company also invests in emerging technologies like immersed energy storage and vanadium flow batteries.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through sales of wind turbine equipment, clean energy power generation, and engineering contracting services. Additional income streams include energy storage system sales and services, integrated energy solutions, and new energy asset development and transfer. The company also earns from government subsidies, investment income, and technology licensing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Windey is positioned as one of the leading domestic wind turbine manufacturers in China with a strong technological edge and growing international footprint. It competes with other major Chinese and global wind equipment manufacturers, focusing on high reliability, efficiency, and comprehensive service solutions. The company is recognized for its innovation and quality, holding a competitive position in both onshore and offshore wind markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Windey reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 22.2 billion, a year-on-year increase of 18.54%, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 465 million, up 12.24%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 38.7 billion, growing 12.22% from the previous year. Sales volume of wind turbines increased by 37.22% to 11,618 MW, with a strong order backlog of nearly 39,867 MW, indicating robust growth momentum and expanding scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Windey emphasizes its advanced technology, comprehensive product portfolio, and integrated service capabilities as key differentiators. It offers high-performance, reliable wind turbines tailored for diverse market needs, including large-scale onshore and offshore projects. The company’s value proposition includes full lifecycle solutions from resource assessment, turbine manufacturing, to operation and maintenance, supported by strong R&D and digital innovation. Its commitment to quality, innovation, and internationalization underpins its competitive advantage.
